{{Quote|General Yoda did stress the importance of keeping a foothold in this area of space.|Admiral Wullf Yularen|<ref name="Shakedown" />}}
The '''Bith system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> Positioned near the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]],<ref name="Rising Malevolence">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> it contained an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Bith system)|astronomical object]] inhabited by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Shakedown" /> Though they shared a name, the Bith were actually [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Colu system]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] commanded by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] was deployed to the Bith [[Star system/Legends|system]] to secure it as a staging ground for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the early [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Shakedown" />
